_about: Rectangles [x0, y0, x1, y1] in each camera's view that never change: frame rails, walls, the light bar. The camera-movement check matches only these, so growing leaves can't fake a move. Checked on 5 Oct against known moves. Camera 3's top band starts at x=420 because the 30 Sep canopy grew into it further left. If a camera is turned and these no longer cover fixed parts, redraw them.
